title: ToolApiV1dot13
description: K-09 Tool API v1.13, a minor version that only adds (T-1539; T-1529's ruling, its card 1, ops/reviews/refusal-reply/rule-refusal.json; DL-1142, DL-1174; README 'v1.13'): gateAndCommit may answer turnRefused, a typed answer for a final refusal of the turn that carries the refusal's labels alone (turnRefusedError: from, fault and ids, each a K-08 v1 safeId, the three labels K-05 v1.23's parkReason takes field for field), and notBuilt, the Tool API base's own answer for a call or a seam not built yet, which v1.13 adopts as K-09's (notBuiltError, in the shape the base answers today: actions/src/tool-api/errors.ts lines 34 to 38). Both are final: the runtime never resends the call or reruns the turn on either, and parks the turn at once through K-05 v1.23's parkTurn (README v1.13 defaults 216 to 220). Which faults are final and which transient is T-1529's ruling 1, listed in README default 217 with each fault list's file lines; turnRefusedError holds it: its from is one of the six fault lists the ruling classifies, and a transient fault of them is refused. Every v1.12 definition (tool-api.v1.12.schema.json, frozen by T-1504 and unchanged, referred to here, which refers to v1.11 and down to v1) is here under its own name, each by reference, but gateAndCommit.errors and gateAndCommit.exchange, which v1.13 restates so each takes every earlier value and the two answers more; so every v1 to v1.12 exchange is a v1.13 exchange and a consumer on v1.12 keeps working. Added: the definitions turnRefusedError and notBuiltError; no call and no key, so callName is v1.12's. No named rule: the schema refuses what v1.13's refused fixtures show. Owner: the architect.

turnRefusedError.title: TurnRefusedError
turnRefusedError.description: v1.13 (T-1539; T-1529's ruling 2; README v1.13 defaults 216 and 217): gateAndCommit's answer for a final refusal of the turn, in place of the throw the Tool API base lets out today (actions/src/tool-api/tool-api.ts lines 608 to 613): a fault no retry can change, of the six fault lists T-1529's ruling 1 classifies. Nothing was written: the call's transaction is rolled back, as for every error, so no part, no core action, no open question and no row of the turn moves, and the open question stays at its version. It carries the refusal's labels alone, never a value, a quote or anyone's words: from (which list), fault (the list's own label) and ids (the labels the refusal names), each a K-08 v1 safeId, the three labels K-05 v1.23's parkReason takes field for field, so the runtime parks the turn at once with them as its reason (default 218). A transient fault of the six lists is never answered turnRefused (not, below): it is thrown as today, so the runtime resends and reruns it as before.

from.description: The fault list the refusal comes from (README v1.13 default 217): walk, the commit's walk (WalkRefusedError: actions/src/commit/walk/errors.ts lines 41 to 76); commit, the commit (CommitRefusedError: actions/src/commit/errors.ts lines 44 to 76); companies, journey 1's companies (CompaniesRefusedError: actions/src/tool-api/journey-1/companies/errors.ts lines 81 to 121); kinds, journey 1's kinds of work (KindsRefusedError: actions/src/tool-api/journey-1/kinds/errors.ts lines 59 to 86); kindsRead and companiesRead, a K-05 read of those two folders that failed the call closed (KindsReadError: kinds/errors.ts lines 11 to 39; CompaniesReadError: companies/errors.ts lines 10 to 43). No other list's fault is answered turnRefused before a later minor version classifies it (open gap 204).

fault.description: The refusal's own label, as its list names it (WalkFault, CommitFault, CompaniesFault, KindsFault, KindsReadFault, CompaniesReadFault), such as stepNotInBundle or secondCompany. A K-08 v1 safeId, so no words, number or address can stand in it.

ids.description: The labels the refusal names, in its own order, each once (a repeat left out, the first kept), and only those that are labels (README v1.13 default 216): step ids, gives keys, the flow letter or row ids for the walk, the commit and the two journey 1 folders (each error class's ids), and for a read's refusal the read's own name (readKindCatalog, readPickedKinds, readBusinessKinds or readTurnState); empty when it names none. Each a K-08 v1 safeId; unique, as K-05 v1.23's parkReason requires.

not.description: A transient fault of the six lists is never turnRefused (T-1529's ruling 1; README v1.13 default 217): the walk's questionNotLive (walk/errors.ts line 53); the commit's wrongState and stillChanged (commit/errors.ts lines 57 and 58); a read's transient (kinds/errors.ts line 20; companies/errors.ts line 21), from whichever list; and kinds' reviewRefused when its ids carry openReviewItem's transient (kinds/errors.ts line 67; kinds/writers.ts line 229). Each is thrown as today and retried.

notBuiltError.title: NotBuiltError
notBuiltError.description: v1.13 (T-1539; T-1529's ruling 2; README v1.13 default 219): the call, or a seam its handler reaches, is not built yet, so nothing was read or written for it (its transaction rolled back). The Tool API base has answered it since T-290 as a package default (actions/src/tool-api/errors.ts lines 1 to 7 and 34 to 38; tool-api.ts lines 595 to 598) for every NotBuiltError a handler throws (the walk's, the commit's, the kinds', the listing's and S1-08's among them); v1.13 adopts it as K-09's own, in the same shape, and rules it final (T-1529's ruling 1: 'every notBuilt'): retrying cannot change it until a deploy binds what it lacks, so the runtime parks the turn at once (default 218). It names the call alone, never the seam or a value.

call.description: The call that answered it (K-09 callName), as the base names it.

gateAndCommit.errors.title: GateAndCommitErrors
gateAndCommit.errors.description: gateAndCommit's errors, as v1.12's (by reference: v1's, as v1.5 to v1.12 keep them), with two more (v1.13, T-1539; README 'v1.13'): turnRefused, a final refusal of the turn with its labels (turnRefusedError; defaults 216 and 217), and notBuilt naming gateAndCommit (notBuiltError; default 219). Both are final: the runtime never resends the call or reruns the turn on either, and parks the turn at once through K-05 v1.23's parkTurn (default 218). Every v1 to v1.12 error is a v1.13 error.

gateAndCommit.exchange.title: GateAndCommitExchange
gateAndCommit.exchange.description: One gateAndCommit request with its outcome, as v1.8's (which v1.9 to v1.12 refer to), its keywords word for word, with one change (v1.13, T-1539; README 'v1.13'): an error answers from v1.13's gateAndCommit.errors, which also holds turnRefused and notBuilt naming gateAndCommit. A request whose decided result holds K-02 v1.2's unmapped end is answered, when it commits, with end asked, once for the turn; every other request's answer holds no end (README v1.8 default 145). Every v1 to v1.12 gateAndCommit exchange is a v1.13 exchange.

if.description: The request's decided result holds K-02 v1.2's unmapped end (decideResult.end).

then.description: The unmapped end is answered asked once for the turn: a committed answer holds end (README v1.8 default 145).

else.description: Any other request: its answer holds no end, as in v1 to v1.12.
